title: task-report
description: The one-line JSON body of the fenced task-report block that ends an implementing agent's final message (.claude/skills/task-completion/SKILL.md). scripts/harness/runspec.py report parses and validates it; the orchestrator verifies every claim against GitHub and the tree before acting on it.

status.description: pr_open: implemented, gates recorded, entry written, pull request open. blocked: stopped; notes names the blocker.

pr.description: The pull request number; required for pr_open.

first_pass.description: false when any gate failed during the task.

deviations.description: "None", or a one-line summary of the Spec deviations field.

files_modified.description: Repository-relative paths the pull request changes.

gates.description: Gate name to outcome, for the gates scripts/harness/gate.sh ran and recorded.

budget_overrun.description: true when the task went past its Budget tier.

notes.description: At most two lines: a blocker, or what the orchestrator must know that the hand-off does not carry.
